sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तुरगान्स मनोजवान् ।आदिदेशाथ शत्रणां मध्येनैव च सारथिः ।। ७.२९.११ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā turagānsa manojavān ।ādideśātha śatraṇāṁ madhyenaiva ca sārathiḥ ।। 7.29.11 ॥

translations.english: Having heard his command, the charioteer then commanded the horses, swift as thought, to proceed directly through the midst of the enemies.
